sections.title: PREAMBLE AND SCOPE
paragraphs: 1.1 KEMSOR STUDIOS PRIVATE LIMITED, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 and having its registered office at Indraprasth, Lane No.6, Near UCO Bank, Dehradun-248001, Uttarakhand, India (the “Company”, “KEMSOR”, “KSPL”, “we”, “us” or “our”), undertakes film production, audiovisual, entertainment, creative development and allied activities.

1.2 This Privacy Policy (“Policy”) governs the collection, use, disclosure, transfer, retention and disposal of personal information obtained through the Company’s website and related digital communications.

1.3 It applies to visitors, prospective employees, artists, casting applicants, writers, creative professionals, vendors and other individuals whose personal information is processed in connection with these activities.
1.4 This Policy shall be read with the Website Terms of Use, Cookie Policy, submission conditions and any specific privacy notices.

sections.title: APPLICABLE LAW
paragraphs: 2.1 Processing shall comply, to the extent applicable and in force, with the Information Technology Act, 2000 and rules thereunder; the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011 to the extent remaining applicable; and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (“DPDP Act”) and Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 in accordance with their commencement.

2.2 Applicable intellectual property and other statutory requirements shall also be observed. Where overseas data protection laws lawfully apply to particular processing, their mandatory requirements shall be respected.

sections.title: DEFINITIONS
paragraphs: 3.1 “Personal Data” means data relating to an identifiable individual. “Data Principal”, “Data Fiduciary”, “Data Processor” and “Processing” shall, where relevant, have the meanings assigned under the DPDP Act. “Website” means the Company’s official website and associated digital forms.

sections.title: INFORMATION COLLECTED
paragraphs: 4.1 Depending on the interaction, the Company may collect: (a) names, contact details, organisation and correspondence; (b) resumes, qualifications, professional experience and portfolios; (c) information accompanying authorised scripts and production proposals; (d) casting profiles, photographs, showreels and audition information; (e) IP addresses, device/browser details, logs and cookies; and (f) subscription and communication preferences.

4.2 Collection shall be proportionate to the stated purpose. Individuals should not transmit unnecessary identification, financial, medical or other sensitive information through general enquiry forms. Additional notices shall be provided where required.

sections.title: PURPOSES AND LAWFUL PROCESSING
paragraphs: 5.1 Information may be processed to respond to enquiries; evaluate authorised applications and submissions; communicate with production partners; administer and secure the Website; maintain corporate and legal records; prevent misuse; comply with lawful obligations; and send marketing communications where permitted.

5.2 The Company shall rely upon consent or another legally recognised basis, as applicable. Materially incompatible further processing shall require compliance with applicable law, including additional consent where necessary.

sections.title: CONSENT AND WITHDRAWAL
paragraphs: 6.1 Where consent is required it shall be informed, specific, unambiguous and obtained through appropriate affirmative action.
6.2 Consent may be withdrawn through an available Website facility or by contacting the designated privacy contact. Withdrawal shall not retrospectively invalidate lawful prior processing.
6.3 Following withdrawal, relevant processing shall cease, subject to lawful exceptions and any permitted or required retention. Withdrawal may affect services dependent upon the information.

sections.title: CREATIVE AND SCRIPT SUBMISSIONS
paragraphs: 7.1 Creative materials shall be accepted only through expressly authorised channels and subject to separate Script and Creative Submission Terms where published.

7.2 Mere submission shall not oblige the Company to review, acquire, finance, develop or produce material; create an employment, partnership or agency relationship; or transfer copyright or other intellectual property.

7.3 Confidentiality, licensing, options and assignments shall be governed by applicable law and separately binding arrangements. Personal information accompanying submissions may be used for evaluation, correspondence and lawful recordkeeping.

sections.title: DISCLOSURE AND SERVICE PROVIDERS
paragraphs: 8.1 Information may be disclosed, where reasonably necessary and legally permissible, to hosting, email, IT and cybersecurity providers; authorised recruitment, casting and production personnel; professional advisers; contractual counterparties; and competent authorities.

8.2 The Company does not sell personal information as part of its ordinary Website operations. Appropriate contractual, confidentiality, access and security arrangements shall be applied to processors acting on the Company’s behalf.
8.3 Lawful corporate reorganisations may involve limited disclosure or transfer subject to applicable safeguards.

sections.title: COOKIES
paragraphs: 9.1 The Website may use necessary cookies, logs and similar technologies for operation and security. Non-essential analytics, advertising or tracking technologies shall be subject to applicable transparency and consent requirements.
9.2 Where required, users shall be offered meaningful preference controls. Further details shall appear in the Cookie Policy reflecting the technologies actually deployed.

sections.title: INFORMATION SECURITY
paragraphs: 10.1 The Company shall implement reasonable technical and organisational safeguards proportionate to the processing risks, including appropriate authentication, access controls, secure transmission, backups, monitoring, confidentiality and incident response.
10.2 Access shall be restricted to authorised persons with a legitimate need. No electronic system can be guaranteed entirely free of security risk.

sections.title: BREACHES AND INCIDENT RESPONSE
paragraphs: 11.1 Actual or suspected breaches shall be assessed, contained, investigated and remediated as appropriate. Notifications to affected persons, the Data Protection Board of India, CERT-In or other competent authorities shall be made where required and within applicable statutory timelines.
11.2 Service providers shall be required, where appropriate, to cooperate in incident investigations and remediation.

sections.title: RETENTION AND DISPOSAL
paragraphs: 12.1 Information shall be retained only as necessary for the stated purposes or as otherwise lawfully required, having regard to contractual obligations, statutory retention, limitation periods and legal proceedings.
12.2 Where no lawful retention ground remains, information shall be securely erased, anonymised or disposed of under applicable procedures.

sections.title: INTERNATIONAL TRANSFERS
paragraphs: 13.1 The Company may engage overseas collaborators and service providers. International access or transfer of Personal Data shall comply with applicable Indian restrictions and relevant foreign legal requirements, including contractual and technical safeguards where required.
13.2 Nothing in this Policy authorises a transfer prohibited by applicable law.

sections.title: INDIVIDUAL RIGHTS
paragraphs: 14.1 Subject to applicable law, commencement provisions and lawful exceptions, individuals may request prescribed information about processing, correction, completion, updating or erasure; withdraw consent; raise grievances; exercise statutory nomination rights; and invoke any additional rights under applicable foreign law.
14.2 Requests shall be directed to the privacy contact. Reasonable identity verification may be undertaken and responses provided within legally prescribed periods.

sections.title: CHILDREN AND MINOR ARTISTS
paragraphs: 15.1 General Website enquiries are primarily intended for adults and professional users. The Company does not knowingly solicit children’s personal information through general forms.

15.2 Authorised casting, training or production involving minors shall be subject to appropriate parental or lawful guardian consent, applicable child protection rules and restrictions on prohibited tracking, monitoring or targeted advertising.
15.3 Recording and publicity use involving minors shall require applicable authorisations and contractual protections.

sections.title: THIRD-PARTY PLATFORMS
paragraphs: 16.1 The Website may link to independent third-party services and social media platforms, which maintain their own policies. The Company is not responsible for their independent processing except to the extent imposed by law.

sections.title: BUSINESS TRANSFERS
paragraphs: 17.1 In a lawful merger, restructuring, acquisition or business transfer, relevant information may be disclosed to authorised advisers or counterparties subject to confidentiality, security and any necessary notices or consents.

sections.title: PRIVACY CONTACT AND GRIEVANCES
paragraphs:
18.1 Privacy requests and grievances may be addressed to:
KEMSOR STUDIOS PRIVATE LIMITED
Registered Office: Indraprasth, Lane No. 6, Near UCO Bank, Dehradun,248001, Uttarakhand, India
Designated Privacy/Grievance Contact: Annil Singh, Director Legal and Finance
Email: info@kemsorstudio.com

18.2 The Company shall maintain an appropriate grievance mechanism and comply with the response and resolution periods prescribed under applicable law. Statutory escalation rights to competent authorities remain unaffected.

sections.title: AMENDMENTS
paragraphs: 19.1 The Company may amend this Policy to reflect changes in law, technology or operations. Revised versions shall be published with an effective date; additional notice or consent shall be obtained where legally required.

sections.title: SEVERABILITY
paragraphs: 20.1 If any provision is held invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall continue to operate to the extent permitted by law.

sections.title: GOVERNING LAW AND STATUTORY RIGHTS
paragraphs: 21.1 This Policy shall be interpreted under the laws of India, without excluding mandatory foreign laws applicable to particular processing activities.
21.2 Nothing herein restricts non-excludable rights, statutory jurisdiction or liabilities. In the event of conflict, mandatory law shall prevail.
